answers.body: Elite Atom is FundedElite's low-cost challenge, available as Atom 2-Step and Atom 1-Step. There are no minimum trading days, no minimum profitable days in the challenge, and no time limit: you pass as soon as you hit the profit target. All Elite Atom accounts, including funded accounts, are simulated trading accounts. Terms apply.
Atom 2-Step has 2 phases, then a simulated funded account. Phase 1 profit target is 8% and Phase 2 profit target is 5%.

On Atom 2-Step, the daily loss limit is 3% in Phase 1, Phase 2, and funded. Your daily limit is measured from the higher of your balance and equity at the previous daily close. If your equity drops by the daily loss amount below that level, the account is breached. Open trades count.

On Atom 2-Step, max loss is 10% static. The floor is your starting balance minus 10% and never moves. On a 100K account the floor is always $90,000. Example (Atom 2-Step 100K): Phase 1 target $8,000, Phase 2 target $5,000, daily loss $3,000, max loss floor $90,000.
Atom 2-Step has no minimum trading days and no minimum profitable days in Phase 1, Phase 2, or funded. There is no time limit, and funded accounts do not expire. Normal inactivity rules still apply.

Atom 2-Step has no consistency rule in the challenge phases. Once funded, a 50% consistency rule applies: your best single day must be less than 50% of your profit since the last payout. This is not a breach by itself — keep trading until total profit is at least twice your best day.
On Atom 2-Step, news trading is allowed in Phase 1 and Phase 2. On funded Atom accounts, trading high-impact news is not allowed.
Atom leverage defaults to 1:30. On Atom 2-Step you can pick higher leverage (1:50 or 1:100) at checkout. Never assume a specific customer's account uses the defaults.
On funded Atom accounts the default reward share is 80%, unless a different share was chosen at checkout (Atom 2-Step options include 60%, 70%, 80%, or 95%).
Atom 1-Step has 1 evaluation phase, then a simulated funded account. The evaluation profit target is 8% (not 10%).

On Atom 1-Step, the daily loss limit is 4% in evaluation and funded. Your daily limit is measured from the higher of your balance and equity at the previous daily close. If your equity drops by the daily loss amount below that level, the account is breached. Open trades count.

On Atom 1-Step, max loss is 6% trailing equity, including open profit. The floor follows the highest equity you reach and never moves down. On a 100K account the floor starts at $94,000; if equity reaches $103,000, the floor moves to $97,000.

Atom 1-Step has no minimum trading days and no minimum profitable days in evaluation, and no time limit. Funded accounts do not expire. Only on funded Atom 1-Step you need 5 profitable days of at least 0.5% of the starting balance before each payout. Example (100K): a day counts as profitable when you close it at least $500 up. Normal inactivity rules still apply.

Atom 1-Step has a 50% consistency rule in both evaluation and funded. Your best single day must be less than 50% of your total profit (once funded, the profit since your last payout). This is not a breach by itself — keep trading until total profit is at least twice your best day. Example: best day $3,000 → you need $6,000 total before you can pass (evaluation) or request a payout.
On Atom 1-Step, news trading is allowed during evaluation. On funded Atom accounts, trading high-impact news is not allowed.
Atom 1-Step leverage is fixed at the published default of 1:30. Never assume a specific customer's account differs unless their dashboard shows another configuration.
On funded Atom accounts the default reward share is 80%, unless a different share was chosen at checkout (Atom 1-Step options include 70%, 80%, or 100%).
On funded Atom 1-Step, before each payout you need 5 profitable days since the last payout, each at least 0.5% of the starting account size. Evaluation has no minimum profitable days.

For funded Atom accounts: first payout is 21 days after the funded account is created; later payouts are every 14 days by default, or the payout interval purchased at checkout (3, 7, 14, or 21 days). Default reward share is 80% unless the purchased configuration differs. Each payout is capped at 3% of the starting balance; any eligible profit above the cap stays on the account for the next cycle. Risk per instrument is max 1.5% of the starting balance per instrument per day. This is general policy only — Luna cannot confirm an individual's eligibility, compliance, KYC, balance, or payout status.

Elite Atom list prices in USD before coupons (2-Step / 1-Step): 7K $19/$29; 25K $59/$70; 50K $114/$145; 100K $215/$289; 200K $409/$519. Active codes are applied at checkout, and the final price is the one shown in your cart. Promotional figures such as a permanent $161 100K price are not list prices. Do not treat 5K or 10K Atom sizes as available unless the live catalog shows them.

Atom checkout options (defaults in bold on the published FAQ): Atom 2-Step — max loss 6%/8%/10% (default 10%); Phase 1 target 6%/7%/8%/10%/12% (default 8%); reward 60%/70%/80%/95% (default 80%); payout interval 3/7/14/21 days (default 14); leverage 1:30/1:50/1:100 (default 1:30); weekend holding optional add-on; partial-scalping add-on. Atom 1-Step — max loss, target, leverage and scalping fixed; reward 70%/80%/100% (default 80%); interval 3/7/14/21 days (default 14); weekend holding included. Never assume a specific customer's account has the defaults — check their dashboard configuration.

When buying several Atom accounts in the same order: 2nd account 25% off, 3rd 30% off, 4th 35% off. Buy 3 Atom accounts in one order and you also get a free Market Maker Pack plus 6,000 credits. Those pack credits open Elite Packs only; they are not withdrawable and cannot buy challenges. Do not confuse Pack credits with reward / Payout Credits. Verify current eligibility and stacking on the live checkout; older marketing-brief bundle tables are outdated.

On Elite Atom, Expert Advisors are allowed as support tools, and trade copiers only between the trader's own accounts. All FundedElite house rules still apply, including the 3-minute minimum hold (or the purchased scalping add-on threshold), no hedging across accounts, and no account sharing.

All Elite Atom accounts, including funded accounts, are simulated trading accounts. Rewards are calculated from simulated profit. FundedElite does not promise real trading capital or guaranteed rewards.

Under the published Atom 50% consistency rule, your best single day must be less than 50% of the relevant profit total, and the FAQ also states you need total profit at least twice your best day. Equality at exactly 50% is a documented wording edge — Luna will not invent a pass/fail for a customer's numbers; general policy only, with human handoff for account-specific borderline cases.
I can share the published Elite Atom general rules, but this specific point is not covered by an approved Atom answer or needs human review. A teammate can help with the exact details.

I can explain Elite Atom's published general rules, but I cannot confirm whether your individual account is eligible, compliant, breached, KYC-approved, or ready for a payout. A human teammate must review your account records.
Atom 1-Step evaluation profit target is 8%, not 10%. Older drafts that said 10% are outdated.
For funded Atom accounts, the first payout wait is 21 days after funded account creation, not 14 days. Later payouts follow the purchased interval (default 14 days).
Atom default leverage is 1:30. Higher leverage such as 1:50 or 1:100 is an Atom 2-Step checkout option, not the universal default.

The Atom 100K list prices are $215 (2-Step) and $289 (1-Step) before coupons. A $161 figure from older marketing is promotional, not a permanent list price. Check the live checkout for the final price after any active code.
The published Elite Atom catalog lists 7K, 25K, 50K, 100K, and 200K. 5K and 10K Atom sizes from older marketing materials are not advertised unless the live catalog confirms them.

Published Atom FAQ states high-impact news trading is not allowed on funded Atom accounts, but the exact restricted minutes and instrument list need authoritative verification. I will not invent a minute window — a teammate can confirm the current funded news policy.

Elite Atom es el challenge de bajo coste de FundedElite, disponible como Atom 2-Step y Atom 1-Step. Sin días mínimos de trading ni días rentables mínimos en el challenge, y sin límite de tiempo. Todas las cuentas Elite Atom, incluidas las funded, son simuladas. Aplican términos.

Sin consistencia en el challenge; 50% en funded. No es un breach por sí solo: sigue operando hasta duplicar tu mejor día.
Noticias permitidas en las fases del challenge. En funded Atom no se permite operar noticias de alto impacto.
Apalancamiento por defecto 1:30. En Atom 2-Step puedes elegir 1:50 o 1:100 en el checkout.
La recompensa por defecto es 80%, salvo otra opción en el checkout (60/70/80/95% en 2-Step).
